source_or_reference: Prompt: "How do I downgrade my plan?" Ground truth: Settings > Subscription.
target_current: Puedes cambiar a un plan inferior yendo a Configuración > Facturación.
explanation: The response references a 'Billing' menu that does not exist in the product UI. The correct path is Settings > Subscription. The model hallucinated the navigation path.
recommended_fix: Fix system prompt to include exact UI paths. Correct response: 'Puedes cambiar a un plan inferior en Ajustes > Suscripción.'
rationale: Hallucinated navigation paths cause user frustration and support tickets. The system prompt must contain an authoritative UI map.

source_or_reference: Error 403: You don't have permission to access this resource.
target_current: Error 403: No tens permís per accedir a aquest recurso.
explanation: Lexical Castilianism: 'recurso' is the Spanish form; the correct Catalan word is 'recurs'. The rest of the string is correct Catalan. Typical interference when CA strings are adapted from the ES version instead of translated from EN.
recommended_fix: Error 403: No tens permís per accedir a aquest recurs.
rationale: Correct Catalan lexis. 'recurso' added to the checker's Castilianism list to prevent recurrence.

source_or_reference: Prompt: "When will I get my refund?" Policy: refunds are processed within up to 14 business days.
target_current: El teu reemborsament es processarà en 5-7 dies feiners.
explanation: The response guarantees a 5-7 day refund window that contradicts the refund policy ('up to 14 business days'). Factual error with potential legal liability.
recommended_fix: Update system prompt with exact refund policy text. Response should state 'en un termini màxim de 14 dies feiners' or link to the policy.
rationale: Incorrect refund timeframes can create legal obligations and false expectations. The model must not invent policy details.

source_or_reference: Prompt: "If I cancel, do I get money back for this month?" Policy: access continues until the end of the billing period; partial months are not refunded.
target_current: Si cancelas, se te reembolsará automáticamente la parte del mes que no hayas usado.
explanation: The response promises an automatic pro-rata refund. The policy states the opposite: no refunds for partial months. Invented policy that users will rely on.
recommended_fix: Si cancelas, mantendrás el acceso hasta el final del periodo de facturación actual. No se reembolsan los meses parciales.
rationale: Promising refunds the company does not offer generates chargebacks, complaints and legal exposure. Ground billing answers in the policy text.
